acceptance_criteria: No artifact claims a current verdict without source revision and observation time.
Error taxonomy has one normative source and artifact catalogs are receipts or historical snapshots.
Independent runs cannot overwrite one global ledger.
Historical evidence remains traceable and explicitly non-current.
References resolve to run-scoped artifacts or normative sources.
A guard detects fixed-path collision, missing provenance, and stale current claims.
Manifests never imply private local evidence is publicly reproducible.

falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The finding would be falsified by immutable run-scoped manifests with revision and observation provenance plus collision and staleness enforcement. Exact-main has none. Consumer migration and historical disposition require implementation-time inventory.
impact: Fixed global ledgers claim current readiness without current provenance, can be overwritten by independent runs, and are invisible to the existing work-index guard.
